title: Luminaires for Road and Street Lighting (LED) — Safety & Photometric Performance
scope: Specification for outdoor LED street lighting luminaires intended for municipal roadways, state highways, flyovers, urban avenues, and municipal road infrastructure operating on AC 230V 50Hz single-phase or 415V three-phase systems.
description: Comprehensive standard covering general electrical and mechanical construction, optical distribution, photobiological retinal safety, thermal dissipation, dust and moisture ingress protection (IP66), surge resistance, and minimum lumen efficiency.
technical_requirements: Luminous system efficacy >= 120 lumens per Watt at rated operating temperature
Correlated Color Temperature (CCT) between 4000K to 5700K with CRI >= 70
Driver efficiency >= 90% at full rated load with Power Factor >= 0.95
Total Harmonic Distortion (THD) <= 10% under nominal operating conditions
Optical and driver chamber Ingress Protection rating: IP66 minimum
Built-in Surge Protection Device (SPD) withstand capacity >= 10 kV / 5 kA
Operating ambient temperature rating: -10 deg C to +50 deg C
Housing fabricated from pressure die-cast high-grade aluminium alloy with powder coating >= 60 microns
normative_references: DEMO-STD-002: Electronic Controlgear / Drivers for LED Road Lighting
DEMO-STD-003: Photometric Testing and Lumen Maintenance Measurement Protocols
test_methods: Photometric flux and candela distribution test using Type-C goniophotometer
Ingress protection test according to IP66 water jet and dust chamber criteria
High voltage dielectric test at 2.5 kV AC for 60 seconds
Salt spray corrosion resistance test (1000 hours continuous exposure)
Thermal endurance cycling test at 50 deg C maximum ambient environment
safety_requirements: Class I luminaire electrical shock protection with mandatory earthing terminal
Protective earthing path continuity resistance < 0.1 ohm
Insulation resistance > 20 MOhm measured at 500V DC between live parts and enclosure
Photobiological retinal blue-light hazard safety rating: Risk Group RG0 (Exempt) or RG1 (Low Risk)
installation_requirements: Pole mounting clamp compatible with 48mm to 60mm outer diameter spigot
Tilt angle adjustable between 0 deg and 15 deg with anti-slip interlocking teeth
Tool-less quick-access latch for field driver replacement with automatic power cutoff interlock
External stainless steel (SS304/SS316) screws and fasteners
certification: Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) compliance approval mark
Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) Star Rating voluntary compliance tier
Comprehensive Type Test Report from NABL-accredited test laboratory
amendments: Amendment 1 (2023): Elevated internal surge endurance baseline to 10 kV
Amendment 2 (2024): Raised system efficacy requirement from 105 lm/W to 120 lm/W

title: Electronic Controlgear (Drivers) for LED Road and Outdoor Lighting
scope: Covers AC supplied electronic controlgear and constant-current drivers operating up to 440V AC 50Hz for street lighting and outdoor public illumination.
description: Specifies performance, electrical safety, harmonic suppression, thermal runaway protection, over-voltage withstand, and efficiency characteristics for LED driver units.
technical_requirements: Constant current output ripple <= 5% peak-to-peak
High voltage cutoff protection for input voltages exceeding 320V AC with automatic restart
Withstand voltage capability up to 440V AC for 2 hours without failure
Thermal foldback protection reducing output current if internal temperature exceeds 85 deg C
Minimum operating lifespan of 50,000 hours at rated case temperature (Tc <= 75 deg C)
normative_references: DEMO-STD-001: Luminaires for Road and Street Lighting
test_methods: Harmonic current emissions measurement according to Class C lighting equipment criteria
Endurance test at maximum ambient temperature under continuous operation for 1000 hours
Input surge withstand test up to 6 kV line-to-line and 10 kV line-to-earth
safety_requirements: Output SELV (Safety Extra Low Voltage) compliance where DC voltage <= 60V
Galvanic isolation between mains input and LED output terminals > 3.75 kV AC
Automatic short-circuit and open-circuit circuit breaker response
installation_requirements: Internal mounting inside sealed luminaire compartment (minimum IP65)
Standardised push-in or screw clamp wiring terminals marked with polarity and input rating
certification: Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) certificate
RoHS compliant materials declaration
amendments: Amendment 1 (2023): Mandated 440V phase-to-phase surge withstand for ungrounded municipal grids

title: Photometric Testing, Road Illuminance Uniformity & Energy Rating for Outdoor Luminaires
scope: Standardized methods for measuring luminous intensity distributions, total luminous flux, isolux curves, and calculating road lighting uniformity ratios (Uo and Ul) for municipal lighting designs.
description: Guides measurement procedures, test setups, goniophotometer calibration, and mathematical derivation of longitudinal and overall road uniformity for traffic corridors.
technical_requirements: Overall road illuminance uniformity ratio (Uo) >= 0.40 for major municipal collector roads
Longitudinal uniformity (Ul) >= 0.60 on expressways and trunk roads
Threshold increment (TI) for disability glare control <= 10%
Lumen maintenance measurement conforming to L70 life calculation exceeding 50,000 burning hours
normative_references: DEMO-STD-001: Luminaires for Road and Street Lighting
test_methods: Absolute photometry testing in temperature controlled dark room at 25 deg C +/- 1 deg C
Spectral distribution and colour rendering index (Ra) calculation
safety_requirements: Disability glare limitation to prevent motorist disorientation
Upward light output ratio (ULOR) <= 1% to prevent night sky light pollution
installation_requirements: Photometric design simulation submission (IES/LDT format) required prior to project signoff
certification: NABL Accredited Photometry Test Laboratory Certificate

title: Ergonomic Office Seating & Workstation Chairs for Institutional Procurement
scope: Specifications for ergonomic swivel chairs, executive high-back seating, mid-back task chairs, and conference chairs for public sector offices and government institutions.
description: Defines anthropometric dimensions, durability cycle ratings, pneumatic gas-lift stability, lumbar support adjustability, upholstery abrasion resistance, and tip-over safety.
technical_requirements: Five-prong star pedestal base with minimum diameter of 660 mm
Class-4 pneumatic gas lift certified for minimum user weight rating of 136 kg (300 lbs)
Pneumatic height adjustment range minimum 100 mm with smooth stroke
Synchronous tilt mechanism with multi-position lock and tension adjuster
Seat cushion molded polyurethane foam with density >= 45 kg/m3
Breathable high-tensile polyester mesh backrest with adjustable lumbar pad
normative_references: DEMO-STD-006: Steel Storage Almirahs and Institutional Furniture Testing
test_methods: Cyclic seat fatigue test: 100,000 drops with 102 kg test mass without structural cracking
Backrest cyclic strength test: 120,000 cycles at 45 kg force
Caster and base durability test: 100,000 obstacle crossings under full rated load
Martindale abrasion resistance test: Upholstery fabric withstanding >= 50,000 rubs
safety_requirements: Rearward tip-over stability threshold when subjected to 15-degree incline load
Anti-kickback safety feature on backrest tilt release
Non-toxic polyurethane materials free from hazardous brominated flame retardants
Smooth deburred edge radii preventing clothing entrapment or skin abrasion
installation_requirements: Standard knock-down (KD) packaging with modular fastener hardware and assembly manual
Dual-wheel nylon casters suitable for commercial tile and vinyl office flooring
certification: GreenPro / GreenGuard environmental emissions certificate
ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 manufacturing audit certification
Complete durability test certificate from an accredited testing laboratory
amendments: Amendment 1 (2023): Mandated Class-4 gas-lift cylinder as the minimum baseline for all institutional tenders

title: Modular Office Workstation Desking Systems and Panel Screens
scope: Requirements for modular open-plan workstations, executive desks, partition screens, modesty panels, and integrated wire-management raceways for administrative buildings.
description: Establishes load-bearing capacity, deflection limits, moisture resistance of pre-laminated board, powder coating thickness on steel understructures, and segregated cable channels.
technical_requirements: Tabletop made of minimum 25mm thick exterior grade pre-laminated particle board (Grade I) or MDF
Edge banding: 2mm thick PVC edge-band glued with high-temperature hot-melt adhesive
Understructure: Mild steel tube framing with minimum 1.6mm wall thickness and epoxy powder coat >= 50 microns
Integrated dual-compartment raceway for segregated electrical power and data/LAN cabling
Leveling glides with minimum 25mm vertical height adjustment to compensate for floor unevenness
test_methods: Static tabletop load test: 150 kg sustained center load for 24 hours with deflection < L/250
Moisture resistance test: Immersion swelling limit <= 12% after 24 hours in water
Cross-cut adhesion test for powder-coated metal components
safety_requirements: Low formaldehyde emission conforming to Class E1 threshold
Fire-retardant partition fabric upholstery
Earthing bonding terminal for metal raceway understructure
installation_requirements: Modular interlock system allowing reconfigurability without structural degradation
Pre-drilled wire cutout grommets with ABS covers
certification: E1 Formaldehyde emission certificate
FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) certified wood supply verification

title: Steel Storage Almirahs, Filing Cabinets and Lockers for Government Offices
scope: Specifications for steel storage cabinets, personal lockers, and multi-tier record management units fabricated from cold rolled sheet for record rooms and secretariats.
description: Standardizes steel gauge thickness, three-point locking mechanisms, shelf weight capacities, anti-rust chemical treatment, and security durability.
technical_requirements: Fabricated from Cold Rolled Close Annealed (CRCA) steel sheet with minimum thickness 0.8 mm (body) and 1.0 mm (doors)
Three-way multi-locking bolt mechanism with brass lever tumbler lock and duplicate brass keys
Adjustable internal shelves with minimum uniform load carrying capacity of 60 kg per shelf
Seven-tank anti-rust pre-treatment followed by thermosetting polyurethane powder coating >= 50 microns
test_methods: Shelf deflection test under 75 kg static load for 48 hours
Door hinge endurance test: 50,000 open/close cycles without hinge sag
Scratch resistance test and cross-hatch adhesion inspection
safety_requirements: Smooth hemmed corners to eliminate razor-edge hazards
Anti-tip anchor brackets for multi-tier vertical filing systems
installation_requirements: Shipped fully assembled with protective transit corner cushions and desiccant pouches
certification: NABL laboratory sheet thickness and coating thickness test report

title: High-Strength Thermo-Mechanically Treated (TMT) Steel Bars for Concrete Reinforcement (Fe-500D & Fe-550D)
scope: Applies to deformed high-strength steel rebar produced through controlled thermo-mechanical treatment for reinforced cement concrete (RCC) foundations, flyovers, bridges, and seismic-resistant government civil works.
description: Specifies chemical composition, carbon equivalent limits, minimum yield strength, ultimate tensile strength, percentage elongation, bend/re-bend performance, and rib geometry.
technical_requirements: Yield strength (0.2% proof stress) >= 500 N/mm2 for Fe-500D; >= 550 N/mm2 for Fe-550D
Ultimate Tensile Strength to Yield Strength ratio (UTS/YS) >= 1.10 for high seismic ductility
Elongation at fracture >= 16.0% for Fe-500D grade
Total elongation at maximum force (Agt) >= 5.0%
Maximum Carbon content <= 0.25%, Sulphur <= 0.040%, Phosphorus <= 0.040%, (S+P) <= 0.075%
Transverse ribs with uniform pitch and height ensuring concrete bond strength >= 1.45
normative_references: DEMO-STD-008: Ordinary Portland Cement for Structural Civil Works
test_methods: Tensile testing on universal testing machine (UTM) measuring 0.2% proof stress and elongation
Cold bend and re-bend test around standard mandrel without transverse cracking
Spectrometric chemical analysis for carbon equivalent determination
Macro-etch examination verifying uniform tempered martensitic rim structure
safety_requirements: Seismic Grade 'D' specification mandatory for earthquake seismic zones III, IV, and V
Traceable manufacturer brand marking, grade, and size embossed on every running meter
installation_requirements: Storage on elevated wooden sleepers covered with waterproof tarpaulins to prevent corrosive pitting
Cutting and bending in accordance with bar bending schedules (BBS) avoiding flame cutting
certification: Mandatory Bureau of Indian Standards product certification license (ISI mark equivalent)
Mill Test Certificate (MTC) accompanying every delivery batch
amendments: Amendment 1 (2024): Strict enforcement of total elongation at maximum force (Agt) criteria

title: Ordinary Portland Cement (OPC 43 & 53 Grade) & Portland Pozzolana Cement (PPC)
scope: Requirements for hydraulic cement suitable for RCC structural columns, beams, heavy road pavements, pre-stressed concrete, and general municipal infrastructure.
description: Defines fineness, soundness, setting times, 3-day/7-day/28-day compressive strengths, insoluble residue, and chloride content limits.
technical_requirements: 28-day compressive strength >= 53 MPa (OPC 53) or >= 43 MPa (OPC 43)
Initial setting time not less than 30 minutes; Final setting time not more than 600 minutes
Specific surface (fineness by Blaine air permeability method) >= 225 m2/kg for OPC, >= 300 m2/kg for PPC
Soundness by Le-Chatelier method <= 10 mm expansion; Autoclave expansion <= 0.8%
Total chloride content <= 0.10% by mass for RCC applications
test_methods: Standard compressive strength cube testing using 70.6 mm mortar cubes at 3, 7, and 28 days
Vicat apparatus test for normal consistency and setting times
Blaine air permeability apparatus fineness determination
safety_requirements: Handling precautions against alkaline contact dermatitis and inhalation of dry particulate dust
Standardised 50 kg HDPE/PP laminated moisture-resistant packaging
installation_requirements: Cement older than 90 days from manufacture date must be re-tested prior to structural placement
Storage in weather-tight godowns with minimum 300mm clearance from walls and elevated wooden floors
certification: Mandatory ISI product certification mark on every bag
Manufacturer test certificate indicating batch number, grade, and weekly strength progress

title: Industrial Safety Helmets (Hard Hats) for Construction and Infrastructure Sites
scope: Specifications for protective headgear worn by construction laborers, site engineers, inspection officers, and maintenance workers to mitigate falling object impacts and electrical contact hazards.
description: Establishes shell material integrity, headband suspension harness cushioning, impact shock transmission, penetration resistance, flame retardance, and dielectric proof.
technical_requirements: Outer shell manufactured from high-density polyethylene (HDPE) or virgin ABS polymer
Shock absorption: Transmitted impact force to headform <= 5.0 kN upon 50 Joule impact
Penetration resistance: Conical 3.0 kg steel striker dropped from 1 meter must not contact headform
Electrical proof test: Withstand voltage up to 440V AC (Type 1) or 10 kV (Type 2)
Six-point or eight-point textile suspension harness with replaceable perspiration sweatband
Chin strap retention with minimum 19mm width and break-away tension between 150 N and 250 N
normative_references: DEMO-STD-010: Industrial Safety Footwear with Protective Toecap
test_methods: Impact transmission test at conditioned temperatures (-10 deg C and +50 deg C)
Flame resistance test using Bunsen burner flame for 5 seconds without sustained combustion
High voltage electrical insulation immersion test
safety_requirements: UV stabilizer additive ensuring minimum 3-year outdoor operational shelf life
Permanent debossed marking inside shell: Manufacturer, Standard ID, Month & Year of manufacture
installation_requirements: Nape-strap ratchet adjustment mechanism fitting head circumferences between 52 cm and 64 cm
Compatible slots for ear muffs, protective face shields, and chin guard attachments
certification: Mandatory Personal Protective Equipment BIS certification license
NABL laboratory impact test report verification
amendments: Amendment 1 (2023): Mandated reflective micro-prismatic tape bands for night shift road workers

title: Industrial Safety Footwear with Protective Steel or Composite Toecap
scope: Specifications for safety shoes, ankle boots, and boots for workplace personal protection against drop impacts, sole puncture, slipping, and chemical splash.
description: Standardizes protective toecap impact clearance, outsole slip resistance on ceramic tile with NaLS lubricant, puncture-resistant midsoles, and anti-static electrical resistance.
technical_requirements: Protective toecap withstands 200 Joules impact energy with minimum clearance height >= 14 mm (Size 8)
Compression resistance: Minimum 15 kN crushing load without collapse
Outsole: Direct injection double-density PU or PU-Rubber with slip resistance coefficient SRC
Penetration-resistant steel or Kevlar midsole withstanding minimum puncture force of 1100 N
Electrical resistance: Antistatic range between 100 kOhm to 1000 MOhm
Upper: Genuine full-grain breathable leather thickness 1.8mm to 2.0mm with water-repellent finish
test_methods: Impact test using 20 kg wedge drop hammer from 1.02 meters height
Outsole flexing test: 150,000 flex cycles on Ross flexing machine with cut growth < 4 mm
Puncture resistance test using 4.5 mm diameter hardened test nail
safety_requirements: Oil and acid resistant outsole compound (volume swell <= 12% in isooctane)
Padded collar and bellows tongue preventing ingress of hot debris and gravel
installation_requirements: Sizing chart conforming to Indian standard foot anatomy scale sizes 5 through 12
certification: Mandatory Quality Control Order (QCO) certification mark
Type test approval for S1P/S3 safety category

title: Energy-Efficient Oil-Immersed Distribution Transformers (11kV & 33kV up to 2500 kVA)
scope: Applies to 3-phase, 50 Hz, outdoor type mineral oil-immersed distribution transformers used in municipal distribution grids, utilities, and public health engineering pumping stations.
description: Sets maximum allowable total losses at 50% and 100% load ratings, copper winding conductivity, insulation oil dielectric properties, temperature rise limits, and tank pressure endurance.
technical_requirements: Maximum Total Losses at 50% load <= 360W and at 100% load <= 1150W for 100 kVA rating (Level 2 Star)
Windings: Electrolytic grade copper conductors with high-purity kraft paper insulation
Mineral insulating oil breakdown voltage (BDV) >= 60 kV after filtration
Maximum top oil temperature rise <= 35 deg C; Winding temperature rise <= 40 deg C over 50 deg C ambient
Core: High permeability Cold Rolled Grain Oriented (CRGO) silicon steel or amorphous metal
normative_references: DEMO-STD-015: Low Voltage XLPE Insulated Armoured Electric Power Cables
test_methods: Measurement of winding resistance, voltage ratio, and vector group verification
Short-circuit impedance and load loss measurement at rated frequency
Lightning impulse withstand test (75 kV peak for 11 kV winding)
Pressure vacuum leakage test on fully assembled corrugated steel tank
safety_requirements: Pressure relief device (PRD) with visual flag and trip contacts
Conservator tank with magnetic oil level gauge and silica gel dehydrating breather
Double independent earthing terminals on tank body
installation_requirements: Plinth mounting or two-pole structure mounting with bi-directional roller wheels
Cable end boxes for both HT (11kV) and LT terminals for outdoor tamper-proof connection
certification: Mandatory BEE Energy Efficiency Star Label (Minimum 3-Star or Level 2)
Mandatory BIS product license certificate
amendments: Amendment 1 (2023): Tightened maximum loss limits by 6% in accordance with updated BEE guidelines

title: High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE) Pipes for Potable Drinking Water Supply
scope: Specifications for solid wall PE-80 and PE-100 grade HDPE pressure pipes for municipal drinking water conveyance, rural piped water supply schemes, and irrigation mains.
description: Defines virgin polymer raw material grades, hydrostatic burst pressures, carbon black dispersion, melt flow rate, oxidation induction time (OIT), and potable hygiene standards.
technical_requirements: Manufactured exclusively from 100% virgin PE-100 grade polymer resin with MRS >= 10.0 MPa
Pressure ratings: PN 6, PN 10, PN 12.5, and PN 16 conforming to standard dimension ratio (SDR)
Uniform carbon black content: 2.0% to 2.5% by mass with dispersion rating <= Grade 3
Oxidation Induction Time (OIT) >= 20 minutes tested at 200 deg C ensuring thermal stability
Melt Flow Rate (MFR 190 deg C / 5.0 kg): 0.2 to 1.1 g/10 min with MFR difference <= 20% after processing
test_methods: Long-term hydrostatic pressure test: Withstand 100 hours at 20 deg C and 165 hours at 80 deg C without rupture
Tensile strength at yield >= 19 MPa with elongation at break >= 350%
Overall migration test proving suitability for potable drinking water without chemical leaching
safety_requirements: Zero toxicity and compliance with public health standards for drinking water contact
Continuous indelible blue co-extruded identification stripes indicating potable water use
installation_requirements: Joined using butt-fusion or electrofusion welding with automated data-logging welding machines
Trench bedding on 100mm compacted stone-free sand bed
certification: Mandatory ISI product certification mark on every 1-meter interval
Food-grade suitability certification for polymer raw material
amendments: Amendment 1 (2023): Strictly prohibits use of recycled or reprocessed plastic materials

title: Commercial Desktop Personal Computers for Institutional and Government Offices
scope: Specifications for enterprise desktop computing systems, micro tower workstations, and small form factor PCs procured for administrative workflows, digital record maintenance, and e-governance.
description: Standardizes processor performance tiers, hardware TPM 2.0 security, power supply 80-Plus efficiency, OEM motherboard architecture, keyboard/mouse durability, and OS compliance.
technical_requirements: Processor: Latest generation x86 64-bit multi-core CPU with benchmark score >= 12,000 points
Memory: Minimum 16 GB DDR4/DDR5 RAM expandable up to 64 GB across dual DIMM slots
Storage: Minimum 512 GB PCIe Gen4 NVMe M.2 Solid State Drive (SSD)
Motherboard: Enterprise OEM motherboard with integrated hardware TPM 2.0 cryptographic chip
Power Supply: Minimum 260W internal SMPS with 80-Plus Bronze or higher energy efficiency certification
Display: 23.8-inch Full HD (1920x1080) IPS panel with low blue light certification and height-adjustable stand
normative_references: DEMO-STD-014: Online Uninterruptible Power Supply Systems
test_methods: Acoustic noise emission testing: Sound pressure <= 25 dBA at idle desk position
Electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) testing conforming to Class B commercial devices
Shock and thermal environmental stress screen (ESS)
safety_requirements: Chassis intrusion sensor alerting BIOS upon unauthorized case opening
Electrical safety insulation conforming to IT equipment standards (touch current < 3.5 mA)
installation_requirements: Pre-loaded with genuine operating system and endpoint security driver management
Comprehensive 3-year or 5-year onsite OEM warranty with next-business-day response
certification: Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) IT equipment safety certification
Energy Star 8.0 compliant certification and EPEAT Gold/Silver registration
RoHS and CE compliance certificates
amendments: Amendment 1 (2024): Elevated baseline storage standard to pure NVMe SSDs (eliminating mechanical HDDs as primary boot drive)

title: Online Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) Systems (1 kVA to 20 kVA)
scope: Applies to true online double-conversion UPS systems providing regulated uninterrupted AC power to mission-critical IT servers, telecom infrastructure, hospital diagnostic units, and administrative data centers.
description: Specifies pure sine wave output, total harmonic distortion, battery management, transfer time (zero milliseconds), input power factor correction, and galvanic isolation.
technical_requirements: Topology: True online double conversion (VFI-SS-111)
Output waveform: Pure sine wave with Total Harmonic Distortion (THDv) <= 2% on linear load, <= 4% on non-linear load
Transfer time: 0 milliseconds (zero interruption during mains failure)
Input power factor >= 0.99 with IGBT-based active power factor correction (PFC)
Overload capacity: 125% for 10 minutes, 150% for 1 minute with automatic static bypass transition
Battery bank: Valve Regulated Lead Acid (VRLA) or Lithium-Iron-Phosphate (LiFePO4) with smart 3-stage charger
test_methods: Dynamic step load response test: Output voltage variation within +/- 5% for 0-100% step load change
Efficiency testing across 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100% load steps (> 92% overall efficiency)
Static and maintenance bypass operation verification
safety_requirements: Galvanic isolation transformer option on output stage for zero neutral-to-earth voltage
Automatic battery disconnection in case of thermal runaway or over-charging current
Emergency Power Off (EPO) port connector for facility safety integration
installation_requirements: Floor-standing tower or 19-inch rack-mount chassis with heavy-duty caster wheels
RS-232, USB, and optional SNMP card slot for remote network monitoring
certification: Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) UPS safety registration
ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 manufacturing quality standards

title: Cross-Linked Polyethylene (XLPE) Insulated Armoured Electric Power Cables (1.1 kV)
scope: Covers single-core, two-core, three-core, and four-core XLPE insulated, PVC inner sheathed, galvanized steel wire/strip armoured electric power cables rated for 1100V working voltage in municipal, commercial, and industrial power distribution.
description: Standardizes copper and aluminium conductor stranded compact geometry, cross-linked insulation thickness, armour coverage percentage, outer PVC sheath flame retardance (FRLS), and continuous current ratings.
technical_requirements: Conductor: High-conductivity stranded compacted aluminium (Class 2) or annealed electrolytic copper
Insulation: Extruded cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) suitable for continuous 90 deg C conductor temperature and 250 deg C short circuit
Armouring: Galvanized steel round wire or formed strip covering minimum 90% surface area for mechanical crush protection
Outer Sheath: Flame Retardant Low Smoke (FRLS) PVC compound Type ST2
Oxygen index >= 29% and temperature index >= 250 deg C for flame retardant jacket
test_methods: High voltage water immersion test at 3 kV AC for 5 minutes
Conductor electrical resistance measurement at 20 deg C
Hot set test on XLPE insulation: Maximum elongation <= 175% under 20 N/cm2 stress at 200 deg C
Flammability test on cable bunched specimens (IEC 60332 / IS equivalent protocol)
safety_requirements: Acid gas emission from sheath <= 20% by weight to protect personnel and control rooms during fire
Smoke density light transmittance >= 40% during combustion
installation_requirements: Minimum bending radius: 12 times cable overall diameter for multi-core armoured cables
Supplied on non-returnable heavy-duty wooden or steel drums with both ends sealed against water ingress
certification: Mandatory ISI product certification mark on outer sheath every 1 meter
Type Test report covering mechanical, electrical, and fire endurance criteria
amendments: Amendment 1 (2023): Mandated FRLS compound as standard default for all indoor and tunnel installations
